notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rabbi Yishmael ben Zirod transmitting a ruling about cooked wine from Resh Lakish, who said it in Rabbi Chiyya’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2271&lang=en) records that chain.
